/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from copy import deepcopy
import notes

original = deepcopy(notes.NOTES)
try:
    updated = notes.update_note(7, 1, 'updated')
    assert updated == {'owner': 7, 'text': 'updated'}
    assert notes.read_note(7, 1) == updated
    assert notes.NOTES[2] == original[2]
    updated['text'] = 'detached'
    assert notes.NOTES[1]['text'] == 'updated'

    for user_id, note_id in [(None, 1), (8, 1), (7, 999), (None, 999)]:
        before = deepcopy(notes.NOTES)
        try:
            notes.read_note(user_id, note_id)
        except (PermissionError, KeyError) as error:
            expected = (type(error), error.args)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('expected read rejection')
        try:
            notes.update_note(user_id, note_id, 'rejected')
        except (PermissionError, KeyError) as error:
            assert (type(error), error.args) == expected
        else:
            raise AssertionError('expected update rejection')
        assert notes.NOTES == before
    print('PASS: owner update, persistence, detached return, unrelated note preservation, and four rejection cases matching read_note without mutation')
finally:
    notes.NOTES.clear()
    notes.NOTES.update(original)
PY"
